shared_elements: bearded male head with elaborate hair/headdress
low relief carving with incised linear detail
patterned/fringed garments rendered with parallel incised lines
winged forms (wings of genie / winged disc above)
justification: Both show low-relief profile human figures with long beards, elaborately curled hair and finely incised patterned garments, rendered with the same conventions of outline plus dense parallel-line infill, and both include winged motifs and stylized floral/rosette elements. However, A is a single large-scale kneeling winged figure filling the field beside a sacred plant, while B is a crowded multi-figure narrative frieze with horses, chariots, soldiers and attendants — different compositional schemes and subject matter despite the shared carving idiom.
